gates.claim: THE NEGATIVE THAT MATTERS. The anharmonic map y -> 1 - 1/y carries the 5_2 saddle cubic ONTO X^3-X+1 (roots = negated plastic numbers), and it does so as an identity of RATIONAL FUNCTIONS -- checked at generic points where the cubic does not vanish, so it is not a modular coincidence. Routes 41/47/48 closed their alphabets under 1-z and 1/z, which generate that group, so every relation Route 54's pentagon produces at (y_3,y_1) was ALREADY inside them. Route 54's theorem does not add rank; it explains the plastic tower of Routes 40-48
the pentagon's fourth argument lands there: a_4 = 1 - y_3*y_1 = 1 - 1/y_2 is a root of X^3-X+1, i.e. minus a plastic number. This is the concrete face of G1

the two composite arguments are exceptional, all four facts exact and verified symbolically by Groebner reduction against a+b+c=2, ab+ac+bc=3, abc=1: a_5 = 1/a_3 (equivalent to the cubic itself), 1-a_3 = conj(a_3), and |a_3|^2 = y_3. So L(a_3)+L(a_5) is elementary by inversion and the degree-6 elements CANCEL out of the relation, leaving only the degree-3 orbit -- which is why the degree-6 field does not rescue the rank either

the relation Route 54 proves, written out at (y_3,y_1): L(y_3)+L(y_1)+L(a_4) = pi^2/2 - [L(a_3)+L(1/a_3)], with a_4 minus a plastic number and the bracket elementary. Route 47's closed form for the y-orbit sum is re-verified alongside it at 60 dps, unchanged

the target is unmoved, and this route moves it FURTHER from reach, not closer: G1 says the relation Route 54 proved was already in the alphabets whose rank gap has been exactly 1 four times over. A = sum Li2(y_j) still has no proof

verdict.structural: y -> 1 - 1/y carries the 5_2 saddle cubic onto X^3-X+1 as an identity of rational functions. The saddle orbit and the (negated) plastic orbit are ONE anharmonic orbit.
verdict.negative: so Route 54's pentagon relation was already inside the alphabets of Routes 41/47/48, all closed under 1-z and 1/z. It does not add rank.
verdict.explains: why the plastic tower kept surfacing through Routes 40-48 -- same orbit, not a coincidence.
